verdict.rationale: Adyen docs explicitly confirm offline payment support ('continue making point-of-sale payments if offline payments have been enabled') and terminals that 'stay up and running, even when the internet is down,' directly matching the store-and-forward reliability story. Missing for 10: no detail on the store-and-forward reconciliation mechanics, transaction limits/risk controls during offline mode, or independent/hands-on confirmation of offline behavior in production.
